items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5 Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau: * Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công. * Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng. Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp). # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria: * The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result. * The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event. Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid). # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png)

items.name: 24 Hours in Åker 2024
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken [koncept](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). ----- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, den nordligaste kubtävlingen i Sverige någonsin! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Du behöver bara befinna dig i tävlingslokalen när de grenar du själv ska tävla i går av stapeln. Check-in kan genomföras när som helst under tävlingshelgen, så du behöver ej infinna dig på fredag kväll enbart för detta. ----- Welcome to Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, the northernmost competition in Sweden ever! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.' **N.B.:** You only need to be in the competition venue when the events you are going to compete in take place. Check-in can be done at any time during the competition weekend, so you don't have to show up on Friday night just for this. items.name: Summer in Bishkek 2024
items.information: Русский Summer in Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Базовый регистрационный взнос за 1 дисциплину составляет 200 сом. За 2 или более дисциплин взнос составляет 700 сом. Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. 10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт" Кыргызча Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. 1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. The basic registration fee for 1 discipline is 200 soms. For 2 or more disciplines the fee is 700 soms. These competitions are organized with the support of the QBERS team. 10 percent of all funds raised will be sent to the international charity organization "Interact"

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: (SRB) Belgrade Summer 2024 je dvadeseto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koliko dana se takmičite. Ukoliko se takmičite oba dana plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD, ali ukoliko se takmičite samo 1 dan plaćate 50% iznosa. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Summer 2024 is the 20th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on how many days you are competing on. If you are competing on both days you will pay the full fee of 2,000RSD, but if you are competing only on one day you will pay 50%. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclp5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3eb495a7327c9da34d21481bc68870f97c1e03ae/image.png) Inscrição de competidor: R$ 50,00 **Por se tratar de um local com tamanho limitado, será permitido apenas um convidado por competidor, sem a possibilidade de adição de novos convidados** Limite de competidores: 40 ​ ​ Registration fee: R$ 50,00 **As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.** Competitor limit: 40 ​ ​ REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita: ​ Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo. ​ Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 40 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com). ​ Para os competidores menores de idade que forem ficar desacompanhados durante o período da noite, será necessário o envio de uma autorização de um pai ou responsável autorizando a permanência após este horário. Esta é uma competição de 24 horas e portanto atente-se a isso. Caso não possa ficar as 24 horas, não há necessidade, preze pela sua saúde e bem-estar mental. REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted: ​ Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below; ​ Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) To underage competitors that will stay alone during the night period, it will be requested an express authorization of a parent or guardian authorizing the competitor's participation during said period. This is a 24 hour competition, therefore, be attentive to that. In case you're not able to stay the 24 hours, there is no need to, value your health and mental well-being.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Summer 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Summer 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Será um prazer recebê-los. **Dicas:** - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **Tips:** - Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png) Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2024, and the first to be held in the Northern Suburbs! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, with multiple rounds of 3x3, 2x2, and Pyraminx, as well as one round of 4x4 and Skewb. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). **About CubingZA** CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please get in touch by contacting us [here](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.name: Swedish Championship 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing! - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of. - We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBblJ0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--910664c5452a4b18375ac4c16db9c4dc45a97a99/photo_2024-03-11%2021.15.39.jpeg) Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024** Es la segunda competencia del nuevo año 2024. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia official de la World Cube Association. La competencia es abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, el registro esta habilitado desde la página oficial de la WCA. No es necesario tener experiencia, pero los competidores deben estar conocer los Reglamentos El acceso a invitados y espectadores será gratuita. Esta competencia participa en el Mes oficial de recién llegados de la WCA 2024. El proceso de registro dará prioridad a los nuevos competidores para el registro, y los competidores que regresen serán aceptados después. Se considera que los nuevos competidores no tienen ID de la WCA o tienen una ID de la WCA de 2024. Se considera que los competidores que regresan tienen una ID de la WCA de 2023 o anterior. Todos los competidores aún deben seguir todos los requisitos de registro para que su registro se considere completo. Los competidores que ya han competido se pueden registrar en cualquier momento durante el período de registro, pero su registro será aceptado según lo siguiente : * El primer 50% de las plazas, según lo definido por el límite de competidores, está reservado para nuevos competidores. * Si el 50% de los lugares están ocupados por nuevos competidores, los competidores que regresan serán aceptados por orden de llegada. * Si el 50% de los lugares no están ocupados por nuevos competidores antes del cierre de registro dos semanas antes de la competencia, se aceptarán los lugares restantes, hasta el límite de competidores, de los competidores registrados que regresan. _____ **English version** **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024 Is a second competition of the new year 2024. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations The competition is free to spectators and guests. This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following: The first 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. If 50% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. If 50% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours dans le cadre du **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA**. 30% des places seront réservées aux nouveaux venus (voir **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA** au bas de cette page pour plus d'informations). Vous pouvez choisir entre [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (samedi) et [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (dimanche). Ces compétitions sont identiques à l'exception du jour où elles se déroulent. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. C'est une excellente occasion pour les nouveaux venus de participer à certaines ou à toutes les épreuves de 3x3x3 cube, de 2x2x2 cube, de pyraminx, de skewb et de 3x3x3 cube à une main! De plus, dans le cadre du mois des nouveaux venus de la WCA, nous aurons des prix spéciaux et des initiatives pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 30% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours dans le cadre du **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA**. 30% des places seront réservées aux nouveaux venus (voir **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA** au bas de cette page pour plus d'informations). Vous pouvez choisir entre [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (samedi) et [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (dimanche). Ces compétitions sont identiques à l'exception du jour où elles se déroulent. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. C'est une excellente occasion pour les nouveaux venus de participer à certaines ou à toutes les épreuves de 3x3x3 cube, de 2x2x2 cube, de pyraminx, de skewb et de 3x3x3 cube à une main! De plus, dans le cadre du mois des nouveaux venus de la WCA, nous aurons des prix spéciaux et des initiatives pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 30% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2024
items.information: **English** **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.name: Northampton Newcomers A 2024
items.information: **Northampton Newcomers 2024 is a series competition. This competition (the A competition) will take place on Saturday morning.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38747-competitor-information) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age. **This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38839-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnhmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7ba00c92956d73843dac03263db2d54fe08848f8/image.png)

items.information: ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. #### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration** Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following: 1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration. 2. Changes to registration (if appplicable). 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. #### **Check-In** Competitors will receive a name tag. #### **Staff Member Registration** Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7074cb88987f8a1665e68652fe09ce8f6b104f3b/image.png) Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The exciting series of competitions for 2024 begins with the 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', the first competition of the year, dedicated to new "cubing enthusiasts"! With great joy and excitement, we open the curtain on a series of competitions where new participants will have the opportunity to showcase their talent and love for cubing. items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information: **English** We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony! **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen! **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.name: BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024
items.information: BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin' featuring a variety of unofficial events. The main focus of this competition will be its unofficial events, which are not sanctioned by the WCA. For more details and unofficial events registration, see the [Unofficial Events tab](#35589-must-read-unofficial-events). ## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. ## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. We will be using Cubing Contests for live results for the unofficial events at this competition. See the [Live Results tab](#35619-live-results) for more information. Competition day timing: * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Lunch will end at the scheduled time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. If you like big cubes and blindfolded solving, check out [BASC 57 - Big and Blind 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC57BigandBlind2024), a competition taking place in San Jose the same weekend as this one!

A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir! #### ATENÇÃO ##### É obrigatório o preenchimento do seguinte formulário com o nome do competidor e dos acompanhantes para entrar no condomínio. [link do Formulário](https://forms.gle/ZqBvPD5L4yjKfhPg9) **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have fun! #### ATTENTION ##### It is mandatory to fill in the following form with the name of the competitor and guests to enter the condominium. items.name: Mid Summer Madness Cape Town 2024

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.details: School hall and entrance hall for registration

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: (BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!** Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024! A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil. Nos vemos lá! (EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!** While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*! The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil. See you there!

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information: We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ## VENUE HEAT This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. **Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later. There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event. ================ Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. **Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.name: Greek Nationals 2023

venue.name: “Manos Loizos” Cultural Centre of Municipality of Nikaia-Renti

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkpWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d21635fc0f5cbe802272c9c1169d1a241d81b7bf/394771855_661572126079922_8082539372510634594_n.jpg) Έφτασε επιτέλους η στιγμή που περίμενε τόσα χρόνια όλη η Ελληνική Speedcubing Κοινότητα! Το 2023 βάλαμε στόχο και πετύχαμε να απογειώσουμε το Cubing στην Ελλάδα! Και τώρα να ‘μαστε, μετά από τη σειρά των τεσσάρων "Road to Nationals" Opens μέσα στο 2023 σε τέσσερα διαφορετικά σημεία της χώρας, σε κλίμα γιορτινό και με όλες τις τιμές που πρέπει, να διοργανώνουμε τα πρώτα GREEK NATIONALS στο Speedcubing! Mε μεγάλη χαρά σας καλούμε, μικρούς και μεγάλους, Cubers και Θεατές στη γιορτή του Cubing, τη δική μας γιορτή, για να περάσουμε τρεις υπέροχες μέρες! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2023. Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The moment the entire Greek Speedcubing Community has been waiting for so many years has finally arrived! In 2023 we set a goal and succeeded in boosting Cubing in Greece! And now, after a series of four "Road to Nationals Opens" in four different locations of the country, in a festive atmosphere and with all due honors befitting the occasion, here we stand organizing the first GREEK NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Speedcubing! It is with great pleasure that we invite you, young and old, Cubers and Spectators to the celebration of Cubing, to our celebration, to spend three beautiful days! Please read through the following tabs to find all the necessary information about the 2023 Nationals Important Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register through the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Hike 2 Cube Kenya 2023
items.information: Welcome! This will be the world's first ever WCA competition on top of a mountain! Please go through each and every tab for all the information about this trip, and let the organiser know about any specific quiries you may have. We will be hiking to the top of Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo). It is going to be a 9 kilometer walk to the top, and another 9 to come back down... This competition is recommended for only competitors aged 12 and above. Those who are aged younger may have difficulties walking long distances. It will be a road trip from the capital, Nairobi, to the venue in Machakos, and back. Competitors also have the option to drive up the mountain (provided they have their own personal vehicles) incase they are not in a position to hike. Make sure to inform the organiser in advance if this will be the case.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc3hXIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--010292e1bb6d6bade7c9e99830ccb49a2079c9ad/image.png) **ATENÇÃO** Essa competição será realizada de uma forma diferente das demais, nela você terá que escolher um evento entre os seguintes para participar: 3x3 ou 2x2 4x4 ou OH Pyraminx ou Skewb 5x5 ou Square-1 Você não pode competir em dois destes eventos ao mesmo tempo, se você se inscrever em dois deles, levaremos em conta como se você tivesse escolhido aquele com menos participantes. Ou seja, se a Modalidade A tiver 10 inscritos e a B, 5, e você se inscrever nos dois, nós excluiremos a sua inscrição da Modalidade A. Você não precisa se inscrever em todas as modalidades. Se não desejar participar de nenhuma das duas que acontecerem em determinado momento, não precisa se inscrever em nenhuma. Caso deseje alterar seus eventos, deve contactar os Delegados ou Organização. Quaisquer outras dúvidas, favor contatar os delegados. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition will be run in a different way to the others, you will have to choose an event from the following to take part in: 3x3 or 2x2 4x4 or OH Pyraminx or Skewb 5x5 or Square-1 You can't compete in two of these events at the same time. If you sign up for two of them, we'll take it into account as if you'd chosen the one with fewer participants. In other words, if Event A has 10 entrants and Event B has 5, and you sign up for both, we will exclude your entry from Event A. You don't have to sign up for all Events. If you don't want to take part in either of the two taking place at any given time, you don't need to register for either. If you want to change your events, you must contact the Delegates or the Organization team. If you have any other questions, please contact the delegates **AOS NOVATOS:** Por favor, enviar um email para [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) ou trazer um documento com foto, data de nascimento e nome completo para fins de completação do processo de registro. **FOR NEWCOMERS:** Please send an email to [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) or bring an ID that contains a photo, date of birth and full name to complete the registration process. Inscrição de competidor: R$ 25,00 A entrada do público será livre. Limite de competidores: 40. **HAVERÁ PREMIAÇÕES EXTRAS: 3X3 FEMININO E 3X3 INICIANTES** **TAMBÉM TEREMOS AS CATEGORIAS JUVENIS, NAS QUAIS PREMIAREMOS O MELHOR DE CADA MODALIDADE COM MENOS DE 16 ANOS** Registration fee: R$ 25,00 Guest entry will be free Competitor limit: 40. **THERE WILL BE EXTRA AWARDS FOR: NEWCOMERS AND FEMALES** **THERE WILL BE THE JUVENILE CATEGORIES, IN WHICH IT WILL BE AWARDED THE BEST ON EACH EVENT WITH AN AGE UNDER 16 YEARS** REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 40 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com um dos Delegados através do e-mail. REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact one of the Delegates via email.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara! A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara! From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens. ### Masters and Challengers This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes! ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ### Spectators As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited. ### Volunteering Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### Sponsorship Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners! ### Lucky Draw During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.
